description: Project Farm features independent, data-driven tests of tools, automotive products, and household goods, where the host purchases products himself and subjects them to rigorous head-to-head comparisons. The videos use custom testing rigs and instruments to measure performance metrics like durability, torque, and wear, often revealing whether budget alternatives can compete with premium brands. The channel's core purpose is to help viewers make informed purchasing decisions by showing empirical results rather than marketing claims.
